subject: App times out even after startup_timeout -1

messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: App times out even after startup_timeout -1
parts:
Hi,  I have been following the thread where many folks had encountered this problem,

Error getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization

and were able to overcome it by upgrading to a version that supported the additional params in shiny-server.conf.   I did upgrade to this version and did implement these extra lines in the config files but no luck so far.  The application still times out.    Any ideas on what else can be the solution to this.

Are there any minimum memory requirements for running R on AWS.
